A Phygital (Physical + Digital) item is a physical product linked to a unique NFT on the blockchain. The main difference is that while traditional smart product data is stored on centralized servers, our Phygital item's ownership and authenticity data are secured on an immutable, decentralized blockchain, giving the product true digital asset value and transferability." We record the product's unique digital fingerprint (NFT) on the blockchain the moment it's manufactured. This record includes its production history and original ownership. No third party can forge this NFT or tamper with its history without authorization, as blockchain data is irreversible." Many solutions offer only one-way anti-counterfeiting verification. Our App provides a complete Phygital ecosystem: 1. Unforgeable NFT ownership proof; 2. Exclusive in-app community and reward mechanisms for consumers; 3. One-click function to resell or transfer ownership (emphasizing interactivity and asset transferability)." Absolutely. Our App is designed to abstract the complexity of the blockchain. Customers simply scan the NFC tag, similar to making a contactless payment, to view information. They do not need a crypto wallet or to purchase any cryptocurrency to verify or view their product." There are three main benefits: 1. Build extremely high consumer trust (eliminating counterfeiting doubts); 2. Gain deep customer insights (analyzing user behavior and geographical location via scanning data); 3. Create secondary revenue streams (setting royalties on the NFT for sustained income from the secondary market)." Yes. When you sell the item to a new buyer, the App guides you through the NFT transfer process, ensuring the product's digital history and ownership proof correctly move to the new owner simultaneously."
